text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r s-t-a-r-t-e-d the p-h-a-s-e by c-o-l-l-e-c-t-i-n-g b-a-s-i-c d-e-t-a-i-l-s to m-i-c-r-o t-a-r-g-e-t the p-r-o-f-i-l-e for f-u-t-u-r-e e-n-g-a-g-e-m-e-n-t.
2) the f-i-l-e c-o-n-t-a-i-n-s a t-y-p-e d s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e of m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s de-s-i-g-n-ed to b-u-i-l-d t-r-u-s-t, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a t-r-a-i-l of d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d i-n-t-e-r-a-c-t-i-o-n-s for a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
3) the r-e-c-o-r-d n-o-t-e-s the u-s-e of r-e-d i-r-e-c-t t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r s-t-e-p-s, w-h-i-c-h w-a-s f-l-a-g-g-e-d as a r-e-d f-l-a-g in the i-n-i-t-i-a-l r-e-p-o-r-t.
4) the f-i-l-e i-n-d-i-c-a-t-e-s that p-r-e-v-e-n-t-i-o-n of r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g was a-g-g-r-e-s-s-i-v-e-l-y i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d to k-e-e-p v-i-c-t-i-m-s i-s-o-l-a-t-e-d from e-a-c-h o-t-h-e-r.
5) the c-a-s-e is m-a-r-k-e-d as c-l-o-s-e-d with a n-o-t-e t-h-a-t the m-e-t-h-o-d-s d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-d w-e-r-e a-n-a-l-y-z-e-d for l-a-w e-n-f-o-r-c-e-m-e-n-t r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e.
